page: Microsoft Azure M832ds_12_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors and runs under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server features 832 dedicated virtual CPUs and a massive system memory allocation of 11,400.0 GB, yielding approximately 13.7 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage, the instance includes a 410 GB SSD and is Premium Storage capable, allowing connection to high-performance external persistent disks. However, the local SSD capacity is relatively small compared to the massive system memory. The server does not feature any graphics processing units and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server represents an extremely high-density hardware class designed for massive scale. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the resource density is tailored for workloads requiring massive in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy transactional databases where entire datasets must reside in system memory to avoid disk latency.
